root.name: エイブリィ・デニソン

relations.text: グラフィックス・反射製品での最大の競合である
relations.text_en: 3M is named as a largest competitor in graphics and reflective products

source.label: Avery Dennison 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: For graphics and reflective products, our largest competitors are 3M Company (“3M”) and the Orafol Group.

relations.text: 機能性テープ製品でも競合する
relations.text_en: 3M is also named as a competitor in performance tapes

source.label: Avery Dennison 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: For performance tapes products, our competitors include 3M; Tesa-SE, a subsidiary of Beiersdorf AG; Nitto Denko Corporation; and numerous regional and specialty suppliers.

relations.text: ラベル素材分野の大手競合に挙がる
relations.text_en: UPM Adhesive Materials, a subsidiary of UPM Corporation, is named as a larger competitor in label materials

source.label: Avery Dennison 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our larger competitors in label materials include UPM Adhesive Materials, a subsidiary of UPM Corporation; Fedrigoni Self-Adhesives; Lintec Corporation; Flexcon Corporation, Inc.; and an array of smaller regional and local companies.

relations.text: ラベル素材の競合として名前が出ている
relations.text_en: Lintec is named as a larger competitor in label materials

source.label: Avery Dennison 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our larger competitors in label materials include UPM Adhesive Materials, a subsidiary of UPM Corporation; Fedrigoni Self-Adhesives; Lintec Corporation; Flexcon Corporation, Inc.; and an array of smaller regional and local companies.

relations.text: ラベル素材分野で競合する
relations.text_en: Flexcon is named as a larger competitor in label materials

source.label: Avery Dennison 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our larger competitors in label materials include UPM Adhesive Materials, a subsidiary of UPM Corporation; Fedrigoni Self-Adhesives; Lintec Corporation; Flexcon Corporation, Inc.; and an array of smaller regional and local companies.

relations.text: 機能性テープ製品の競合に含まれる
relations.text_en: Nitto Denko is named as a competitor in performance tapes

source.label: Avery Dennison 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: For performance tapes products, our competitors include 3M; Tesa-SE, a subsidiary of Beiersdorf AG; Nitto Denko Corporation; and numerous regional and specialty suppliers.

companies.name: チェックポイント・システムズ

relations.text: ソリューション部門の主な競合に挙がる
relations.text_en: Checkpoint Systems, a subsidiary of CCL Industries, is named as a primary competitor in the Solutions Group

source.label: Avery Dennison 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In the Solutions Group, our primary competitors include Checkpoint Systems, Inc., a subsidiary of CCL Industries Inc.; R-pac International Corporation; SML Group Limited; Arizon RFID Technology Cayman Co Ltd; and Tageos SAS, a subsidiary of Fedrigoni Group.
